inputText: This is Aleph — AH-lef. Sound: almost silent — a tiny catch in the throat, like the pause in uh-oh. Shape hook: tilted X with a diagonal spine. Tip: Three strokes cross at a diagonal; unlike Tav, there is no top roof; do not mix it up with Tav, Ayin.
